summary: Switch every backgrounded teach-family example from double-quoted to single-quoted query arguments and document an explicit shell-quoting rule, so user-derived text can never be interpolated into a shell string where command substitutions would execute.
description: Switch every backgrounded teach-family example from double-quoted to single-quoted query arguments and document an explicit shell-quoting rule, so user-derived text can never be interpolated into a shell string where command substitutions would execute.
reason: Review feedback on the publication PR: the background-teach template placed the user question inside a double-quoted shell command backgrounded with &, so injected shell syntax could execute with the agent's local privileges. Generated docs and the teach command help example were hardened together.
safety: Docs-and-example-only change; no runtime behavior, network calls, or stored data affected.
